title: Renewal Probability Lab - Q4 scrub & playbook (working)
content:
Sheet: Renewal Probability Lab (working)
Purpose: single-pane renewal scrub + playbook fragments for QBR prep. Use this sheet for the week-of scrub rounds; final outputs feed the QBR deck and renewal playbook PRD.

Columns (current tab): Account | Account_ID | ARR_USD | Contract_End | Days_to_Renew | Renewal_Probability_pct | Probability_Basis | CS_Owner | Last_Contact | Next_Steps | Action_by | Upsell_Opp_pct | Risk_Level | Notes

Rows (sample data - working rows, do not export until final scrub):
Nebula Analytics | NBL-1023 | 145000 | 2027-01-15 | 74 | 85 | Exec sponsor confirmed; product fit; low support volume | Maya Chen | 2026-10-20 | Exec renewal mtg 2026-11-10; send draft SOW + pricing options | Andre Patel | 10% | Low | Legal asked for 90d notice clause; discuss contract amendment; call with legal 11/02
Aster Retail | AST-557 | 92000 | 2026-12-05 | 44 | 60 | Usage down 18% q/q; finance wants commit-to-usage options | Sofia Martinez | 2026-10-28 | QBR + usage deep-dive; propose flexible payment terms and credit for Q4 | Sofia Martinez | 0% | Medium | Needs CFO intro; JIRA:CS-210 (product issues backlog) appended
Orpheus Health | ORP-001 | 420000 | 2027-03-02 | 110 | 95 | Strategic partner; auto-renew clause; customer roadmap aligned | Liam O'Connor | 2026-10-30 | Legal to confirm auto-renew clause + finalize SOW; schedule exec alignment | Maya Chen | 25% | Low | HIPAA addendum in flight; security OK so far
Rivet Fintech | RIV-889 | 210000 | 2026-11-20 | 18 | 30 | Active billing dispute; payment hold flagged by Finance | Andre Patel | 2026-10-22 | Escalate to Finance + CS remediation; pause renewal outreach until resolution | Andre Patel | 0% | High | Finance ticket FIN-452; CFO requested additional discounts; escalate to Sales Ops
Atlas Media | ATL-774 | 56000 | 2027-04-15 | 154 | 70 | Pilot converting to paid; good NPS; wants on-prem POC | Sofia Martinez | 2026-09-18 | Offer 6-month expansion pilot; build POC scope + cost estimate | Sofia Martinez | 15% | Medium | POC cost TBD; potential PRICING exception needed

Formulas & helper cols (sheet notes):
- Days_to_Renew = DATEDIF(TODAY(), Contract_End, "D")  (used in conditional highlight for <30 days)
- Weighted_ARR = ARR_USD * (Renewal_Probability_pct / 100)  (pivot-ready)
- Risk_Level derived: if Probability < 40 -> High; 40-70 -> Medium; >70 -> Low (manual override allowed)
- Last_Contact = date of last substantive engagement (not auto-email)

Conditional formatting / views (recommendations):
- Red highlight when Days_to_Renew <= 30 AND Renewal_Probability_pct < 60 -> immediate escalation list
- Yellow when 31-60 days and Probability < 70 -> prioritized outreach
- Green when Probability >= 85 -> standard renewal cadence

Confidence scoring rubric (for consistent scoring across CS team):
- 90-100%: Contractually captured auto-renew or formal signed intent + exec sponsor
- 70-89%: Strong engagement, finance + legal alignment, minor open items
- 40-69%: Open product/usage concerns or procurement issues; active mitigation plan needed
- 0-39%: Billing disputes, strategic drift, or explicit churn signals

Scrub checklist (weekly):
- Validate Account_ID and ARR matches billing export (link to billing CSV)
- Confirm last_contact date and qualitative note (repater: "what did exec say?")
- Verify finance/legal blockers -> add Jira/FIN IDs in Notes
- Update Probability_Basis (one-line rationale) and owner action w/ due date
- Tag required escalation to Sales Ops / Solutions Eng / Legal in Action_by field

QBR talking points template (per account) - paste into QBR deck notes:
- 1 line summary: "Renewal posture, ARR, probability"
- Top risks (2 bullets): product, finance, legal, engagement
- Next 3 actions + owner + date
- Upsell/expansion hypothesis + expected ARR impact

Action items (working backlog):
- 2026-11-03: Maya to draft SOW template for Nebula adjustments (Andre support)
- 2026-11-04: Sofia to secure CFO intro for Aster Retail; open Confluence page with meeting notes
- 2026-11-02: Andre to confirm FIN-452 status with Finance (update sheet)
- 2026-11-09: Liam to confirm HIPAA addendum sign-off for Orpheus Health

Scenario planning quick tab (manual process):
- Best-case: Convert all >=70% -> weighted ARR baseline
- Moderate-case: Only >=85% convert -> conservative ARR baseline
- Stress-case: Remove accounts flagged High risk -> pipeline gap & required motion notes

Export notes for leadership:
- Produce two exports before QBR: (1) Exec-ready list (ARR > 100k OR strategic flag) with crisp 3-line statuses, (2) Operational backlog (all accounts sorted by Days_to_Renew asc)
- Include columns: Account, ARR_USD, Contract_End, Days_to_Renew, Renewal_Probability_pct, Next_Steps, Action_by

Unresolved questions (to capture during scrub):
- Aster Retail: can Sales Ops approve 60-day billing flexibility without CSM discount? (ask SOps)
- Rivet Fintech: are discounts previously promised by Sales on record? (lookup closed-won notes)

Notes-to-self / informal fragments:
- "If finance still blocks Rivet by 11/10 -> flag as churn-risk in QBR and propose retention credit?"
- "Consider templating a 6-month pilot price for small ARR accounts to increase close velocity"
- "Revisit probability rubric after two scrubs to calibrate consistency across CS"

Linked artifacts / references (append here for scrubbers):
- Confluence: cs/renewal-playbook-v2 (playbook draft)
- Billing CSV export: billing_exports/oct_2026_renewals.csv (internal drive)
- Jira: CS-210 (product backlog), FIN-452 (billing dispute)
- Slack notes: #cs-renewal-thread (thread pinned messages)

- 2026-11-01 Sofia added Aster Retail notes and CFO ask
- 2026-11-02 Andre updated Rivet Fintech finance link and action item

END OF SHEET - working copy. Finalize before exporting to QBR deck (label as FINAL and update status -> final).
